owes.line: the space itself: its size and layout, where things stand, how the light falls, what it is built and furnished with in this period
the people here: how many, what each is doing, how they look and carry themselves, and how they take the investigator's arrival
one or two specific objects or fittings that draw the eye or invite a closer look
at least two senses beyond sight: sound, smell, temperature or texture
the period in things seen and heard, furnished by historical_reference_materials when they came back; never stated as a fact about history
something in the scene that invites the next move; not a question to the player and not a menu
